limitations: Final complete archive with actual042 checker and 172-file private packet requires a separate assembly seam check
Windows interoperability and GitHub authentication were not exercised on the laptop
Tests do not establish OS-level process isolation or general Git credential-helper safety
Static checks do not establish scientific efficacy, novelty or future experiment admission
meaningful_coverage: Full trusted checker JSON result preserved as public REPORT.json with matching report path and SHA-256 in RECEIPT.json
Exactly two public files committed and published; unchanged repeat reuses the same commit
Interrupted REPORT-only file creation and staging recovers an exact two-file commit
Failed commit recovers exact staged outputs; failed push reuses exact committed outputs
Changed staged receipt is preserved and publication stops
Checker exception publishes only a categorical failure report and receipt, omitting arbitrary exception text
Actual extracted launcher loads packaged workflow and siblings, uses a Unicode home path, and recovers a failed push
Packaged command template parses in bash; no native-controller command is invoked
Well-formed structured checker failure is preserved in full with a STOPPED receipt rather than replaced by a hash or generic status
scope: Hosted offline handoff engineering validation; no independent scientific review or actual WSL execution

substitutions.checker: Pinned synthetic checker source loaded through production verify(root,packet) API; reports fixture counts and proof labels only
substitutions.historical_commit: Test module RETURN_COMMIT alone is replaced by an actual fixture ancestor commit
substitutions.transport: Canonical-origin Git transport adapter routes fetch/push/ls-remote only to an explicit local bare fixture remote
